name: roadalert-monorepo
description: RoadAlert — Intelligent Traffic Incident Verification & Response Platform (Nexathon 26)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
